csep_general_threshold_2026.note: Critical Skills Employment Permit general salary threshold, effective 1 March 2026 (up from €38,000). Part of a multi-year DETE roadmap of increases phased through 2030, index-linked to CSO average earnings (historic average ~4.9%/yr).

csep_no_degree_threshold_2026.note: CSEP threshold for eligible jobs not on the Critical Skills list without a relevant degree, effective 1 March 2026 (up from €64,000).

gep_threshold_2026.note: General Employment Permit threshold, effective 1 March 2026 (up from €34,000). HIGH-RISK STALE FIGURE: multiple tier-3 law firms (Tafapolsky & Smith, Mason Hayes Curran) publish €36,505 as current — this is WRONG; the correct DETE/gov.ie figure is €36,605, a €100 difference that could cause an under-threshold refusal.

ict_threshold_2026.note: Intra-Company Transfer permit minimum salary, effective 1 March 2026 (up from €46,000).

sources.title: Department of Enterprise, Trade and Employment — employment permit thresholds, 1 March 2026 update (press release 2 Dec 2025)
